plugins.name: scylladb
plugins.description: Official Claude plugin for ScyllaDB (Skills). Connect to ScyllaDB Cloud, design CQL schemas, implement Vector Search and full-text search, use the DynamoDB-compatible API (Alternator), run ScyllaDB on Kubernetes, manage clusters through the ScyllaDB Cloud MCP server, benchmark ScyllaDB Cloud with cassandra-stress, and migrate Java applications from Java driver 3.x to 4.x.
